info.name: Optibus Operations Driver Absences Statistics API

params.name: date
params.description: - The date for which statistics are to be retrieved. Required, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: depotId
params.description: - The ID of a specific depot for which statistics are to be retrieved. Either depotId or driverIds must be provided.

params.name: driverIds
params.description: - An array of driver IDs for whom statistics are to be retrieved. Either driverIds or depotId must be provided.

params.name: statIds
params.description: - Optional. An array of statistic IDs to filter the results. If not provided, all configured statistics are returned.

items.docs:
Retrieves statistics values for drivers on a specified date.
Statistics are configured in the customer's preferences and can include normal (daily), yearly, and accumulated types.
Normal stats are calculated via the work engine, while yearly and accumulated stats are fetched from the yearly cache.
Either driverIds or depotId must be provided to scope the request. There is a calculation limit per request to avoid timeouts. For normal stats, the limit is based on the number of configured work-enti

info.name: Fetch per-task statistics for a date range

params.name: fromDate
params.description: - Start of the date range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: toDate
params.description: - End of the date range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Must be `>= fromDate`.

params.name: depotIds
params.description: - Optional. Restrict to specific depots; all customer depots if omitted.

params.name: driverIds
params.description: - Optional. Restrict to duties assigned to these drivers.

params.name: includeUnassigned
params.description: - Optional. Defaults to `false` when `driverIds` is provided, `true` when omitted.

params.name: taskIds
params.description: - Optional. Filter by internal task UUIDs (not display IDs). Required when `daysLimit` is `0` — see above.

params.name: statIds
params.description: - Optional. Restrict which statistics to compute. `"*"` is not allowed.

items.docs:
Retrieves per-task statistics for a date range, mirroring the duty side panel in the Ops UI.
One response row per `(date, task)` pair, including the statistics configured under the customer's `dutyFilter` preference.

To avoid timeouts the calculation is capped. Call `GET /v2/duty-stats-calculation-limit` first with
the same dates and depots to size your requests. This endpoint returns 413 when:

Sizing (pre-flight) call for `GET /v2/duty-stats`. It computes no statistics — it only reports the
limits that `/v2/duty-stats` will enforce for the given dates and depot scope, so callers can plan
their requests up front. Call it with the same `fromDate`/`toDate`/`depotIds` you intend to query.
